outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic illustrating the experimental pipeline, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B shows fluorescence, H&E, and brightfield micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid for each region across the Normal, LUAD, and LUSC groups.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) are overlaid for each region in the High pH and Low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic model of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, not a plot of averaged data.
